# pai kg

Facts extracted from your notes, with the time they were true

```
pai kg <command>
```

The knowledge graph stores facts as subject - predicate - object triples, each with the time span it was valid. Use it to ask what was true at a given date, or what changed.

```sh
pai kg stats
pai kg list --limit 10
pai kg query --subject PAI
```

See also: `pai memory search`, `pai zettel`

### pai kg backfill

Extract facts from existing session notes

```
pai kg backfill [options]
```

Reads session notes that have not been processed yet and adds their facts to the graph. Safe to run again; finished notes are skipped.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project SLUG` | string | — | Only this project |
| `--limit N` | number | — | Process at most this many notes |
| `--dry-run` | flag | — | List the notes that would be processed; extract nothing |

```sh
pai kg backfill --dry-run
pai kg backfill --project my-project --limit 20
```

See also: `pai kg stats`

### pai kg query

Look up facts by subject, predicate, object or date

```
pai kg query [options]
```

Prints the facts that match every filter you give. With --as-of it shows what was true on that date.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--subject TEXT` | string | — | Only facts about this subject |
| `--predicate TEXT` | string | — | Only this kind of relation |
| `--object TEXT` | string | — | Only facts with this object |
| `--as-of DATE` | string | — | What was true then (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601) |
| `--project SLUG` | string | — | Only this project |
| `--json` | flag | — | Output raw JSON |

```sh
pai kg query --subject PAI
pai kg query --subject PAI --as-of 2026-01-01 --json
```

See also: `pai kg list`

### pai kg list

List the facts that are true now

```
pai kg list [options]
```

Prints currently valid facts, newest first.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project SLUG` | string | — | Only this project |
| `--limit N` | number | 50 | Maximum facts to print |

```sh
pai kg list
pai kg list --project my-project --limit 10
```

See also: `pai kg query`

### pai kg stats

How many facts and contradictions the graph holds

```
pai kg stats
```

Prints counts of facts and of facts that contradict each other.

```sh
pai kg stats
pai kg list --limit 5
```

See also: `pai kg list`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai kg backfill` | Extract facts from existing session notes |
| `pai kg query` | Look up facts by subject, predicate, object or date |
| `pai kg list` | List the facts that are true now |
| `pai kg stats` | How many facts and contradictions the graph holds |

## Examples

```bash
# Build the temporal knowledge graph from existing memory
pai kg backfill

# Ask the graph about an entity
pai kg query "Talan"

# List known entities
pai kg list

# Graph size and entity-type breakdown
pai kg stats
```
